name: sprint-review
description: Write a sprint review deck from this repository's git history: themes in business language, every line checked against the real commits, before-and-after screenshots.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: The key of the model provider in your sprint-review config: Anthropic by default, or OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter and others. Leave it empty to use the provider's key from the environment Claude Code starts in (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ...), or for a local model.
